title: Opinions wanted! (Solo dev 1st demo)
author: BIGCHUG1404
selftext:
Hey guys! My dad passed away a few months ago, and his passing lit a fire under me to pursue one of my dreams, making games. I’ve made a handful of board games in the past, ran a decade long homebrew Dungeons & Dragons campaign, and worked on a few projects using mods within other games so I have a little bit of design experience, but nothing in the realm of actually making digital games like what is possible with AI nowadays. I’ve been practicing for a few months on some larger long-term projects as I learn and develop my workflow. I started messing around with a concept for a mobile game and it is my first project to make it all the way to the demo stage. I pre-planned and organized the project heavily in collaboration with Claude code, then generated art using ChatGPT Astra and a trailer song using Suno. I then fed all of that prep work into Claude code, running Opus at max settings. This generated a prototype that I’ve been iterating on heavily, making specific requests and even taking screenshots into MS paint for highly specified edits. I designed the idea, the gameplay, the loop, even the little minor filler objectives between A and B. AI helped me organize and then pump out the code once I had made all design decisions. Like I said, this is my very first project to make it this far and I am very much in the learning phase of how to do all of this, and to integrate AI into my workflow, so I am very interested in anyone’s thoughts and advice. Thanks!

https://wiltshire-studios.itch.io/traffic-finger
